novelty_flags.label: Theorem 1 — mixed-measure identification
novelty_flags.one_line: The causal identification claim is already covered by Díaz et al.'s general LMTP identification theorem; retain the formula as known setup rather than a novel root target.

soundness_flags.label: Model class, target estimand, and Theorems 1–4
soundness_flags.one_line: `mathcal M` only bounds a Lebesgue-density version and therefore permits additional conditional singular mass of A, invalidating q_x(delta)=integral pi_x and the claimed pushforward; moreover psi_delta(P) is written with potential outcomes although P is only an observed-data law.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 849, Theorem 1; p. 850, threshold discussion immediately before Assumption 4
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 1 identifies LMTP effects through observed-data sequential regressions; the paper explicitly writes the threshold target as a natural-course term plus a regression evaluated at the threshold and states that it is not pathwise differentiable.

The published article treats the clipped MTP distribution as a pushforward law, defines its ratio relative to an appropriate dominating measure, and states that its classification-based ratio estimator targets that pushforward law.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Make conditional absolute continuity primitive: require P(A in da | X=x)=pi_x(a) da, then define the statistical target first as nu_delta(P)+sum_x p_x q_x(delta)mu_x(delta) and state its causal interpretation only under consistency and exchangeability.

Demote the mixed-measure identification theorem to a cited setup/result and make the first novel headline the matched risk-and-honest-length frontier, explicitly contrasting it with the fixed-threshold upper-clamp discussion in Díaz et al.

Add a formal boundary corollary comparing the lower clamp to the published upper clamp under A'=1-A, making precise which part is inherited identification and which atom-thinning phase transition is new.

For the sharp-constant OEQ, specify a concrete least-favorable mixed experiment or conditional modulus optimization objective, rather than only its workflow handle, to make its proposed construction route testable.

recommended_next_step: Revise the model and target so the mixed-measure functional is defined on every law in the class, recast Theorem 1 as known identification, then advance the repaired minimax-and-honest-inference kernel to Stage 0.
